text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! It's carrot-scented blotting 
paper! 
So cute~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this hairpin over here would look 
lovely on Fine-chan~! 
There are stoles and cardigans too... Oh 
my, what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho, this is the 'running kimono' 
everyone's talking about. 
How about taking a stroll through town in 
this?

text_block_list.name: Fine & Laurel
text_block_list.text: S-So cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Is this antique lace? It looks so 
French...! 
Hey, everyone—!!

text_block_list.name: Laurel & Bubble
text_block_list.text: Waaaaooow!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So cute~! The retro style is so nice! You 
two look just like dolls! 
Laurel is all fluffy, and Ikuno looks so 
romantic... Aah♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You look really cool too, Bubble-chan! 
It feels so 'New Year'♪ Makes you want to 
stand up straight and proper.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa! We've changed clothes too~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Wow, how elegant! It looks so good on 
you! 
Ah, should we take a photo?”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“Allow me, then. 
Both of you, please line up under that 
tree over there.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Okaay! But we're taking turns! I want a 
photo with you too, Ikuno-chan! 
We'll take a bunch, with three of us, five 
of us, everyone! As for the pose—”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“Taking so many photos that look 
practically identical... 
Good grief, you're taking far too many.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Air Groove looks so happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“Of course I am. She needs ‘memories.’ 
Precious memories that will last her a 
lifetime, that is.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“I see... 
In that case, wouldn't a solo shot of you 
make a great memory too?”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: “...Kh! Hey, without my permission?!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Sorry, sorry! You just looked so 
captivating. 
Besides, I'm sure she'll be thrilled when 
she sees this photo.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Because it's a memory of ‘a wonderful 
senior’... 
who was strong, kind, and dignified.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“It is nothing so grand. This is the least 
I can do for her. 
Still... hmph, don't use the flash.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Hey, you two! Come over here, you two as 
well! 
We're taking a group photo together—!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—Phew, we really strolled around a lot. 
Is everyone tired? Shall we take a break 
at a cafe...?”

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
“—‘Kite flying’ is accepting walk-in 
participants right now~~! 
Free to join the New Year's game 
experience! Over at the plaza—”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Kite flying, huh? Sounds fun♪ 
Maybe I'll go check it out.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Then count me in too! 
I was just wanting to run in these clothes 
anyway♪”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Should we split into two groups? 
Send us the cafe's location on LANE and 
we'll meet up with you later~!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, Laurel-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—Now's the time! Umm, against the 
headwind...! 
Ah~~, it's falling back down again~.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Laurel, look. Ikuno came along too. 
She really is worried about you, isn't 
she?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“You're right, heeey...♪ Fufu, is this a 
golden opportunity or what? 
Hey Bubble-chan, care to have a match with 
me?”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Sure. 
Whoever flies it higher wins, sound good?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Yup! As long as it's a match where I can 
run with all my might, anything goes—!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“(Her running form looks normal, but... 
Could fatigue be quietly building up 
without her realizing it?)”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—Here it comes! A good breeze♪ 
Time to make my move!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“Wha...! 
She was still holding back with that 
pace...?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“............Kh! 
Such acceleration... in an instant...”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: “...! The kite... oh, it's soaring...!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“I did it...! Keep going...!  
Ahaha...! Fufufufu—!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Ahahaha! You're so strong even just 
playing around, Laurel. 
...In races, you were even stronger than 
this, though.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“Of course she was...! She is someone who 
achieved a GⅠ victory, after all. 
However, considering her fragile 
condition...”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“I think she's faced her injuries head-on 
more than anyone else. 
Laurel was truly strong in every sense of 
the word, even back then.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Let's see... 
*giggle*, this is something I can only 
share now, but—”
